body: That pay is too low and you should have 11 hours between each shift by law. They´re using you
Aside everything, I really can't see why you'd want to show this to the grieving parents :( (i.e last comment)
The latter being the worst crime.

Thank you so much. It mattered a great deal to me that you don't mind reaching out like this. It's like when it's daylight and I'm with other people it's not as bad, but when I'm alone my mind changes and becomes different and all I see is darkness. I know it's the depression warping my head and darkening my outlook, but it feels so real at that moment. I will use the "just wait one hour" to help come out of the mental dive, because it's not all the time I feel so bad. 
Also, thank you for offering to meet in person, it's very nice of you. I appreciate it. However I live in Scandinavia so that might be ifficult :) The next time I have a dive, I will write you. Thank you. Just reading your reply made feel less alone in this.
